name: machine-learning

shorts.hook: Modern AI started in a bedroom
shorts.say: The AI boom started on two gaming cards, in a student's bedroom.

shorts.hook: This machine learned by turning knobs
shorts.say: One of the first machines that learned had no screen. It had knobs. And it turned them itself.
shorts.from: And here's the part I love

shorts.say: In 2016, a computer played a move so strange that its opponent walked out of the room.
Take the word king. Take away man. Add woman. An AI knows the answer.

shorts.hook: AI bluffs like a student in an exam
shorts.say: Why does AI make things up? Researchers found a very human reason.

title: Every Confusing Thing About Machine Learning Explained Slowly (For Sleep)
